# Vendored Libraries

These third-party libraries are self-hosted here (rather than loaded from a
CDN) so the app has no runtime dependency on external hosts, and are loaded
on demand only when a conversion actually needs them.

| File(s) | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jspdf.umd.min.js` | [jsPDF](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) | 2.5.2 | MIT |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) | 3.10.1 | MIT / GPLv3 (dual) |
| `lame.min.js` | [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) | 1.2.1 | LGPL-3.0 |
| `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs` | [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) | 4.0.379 | Apache-2.0 |

Each project's full license text is available at its repository above.
